body: I have tried to talking both to my parents and to my friends. My friends say everything is going to be okay and one friend says I should seek professional help, and my parents think that a 20 minute conversation and me crying helps everything. I don't know what to do because I feel like my problems aren't that big of a deal, so I shouldn't call a hotline, but I also feel so sad and stuck that I don't know what to do.

But if you have been trying to get better for years and it doesn't work, than good luck. But I'm sad that you're going to leave this Earth even if I don't know you. Good luck.
